text:
joan: Quick sketch — proposing a compact trigger taxonomy for automatic fallback and how the console links samples back to the audit log. PTAL, want to lock vocab before I build the mock.

joan: Draft mapping (super tiny):
```json
{
  "triggers": [
    {"id": "transient_error_spike", "desc": ">3x 1m error rate vs baseline", "mode": "soft-sample"},
    {"id": "sustained_error_rate", "desc": ">5% errors over 10m", "mode": "full-degrade"},
    {"id": "latency_tail_surge", "desc": "p95 latency up 2x over 5m", "mode": "soft-switch"}
  ]
}
```

raj: nit: prefer `soft-fallback` instead of `soft-sample` (makes it clearer to operators). Also add a `severity` field (low/med/high) so the console can auto-suggest operator actions.

sam: Agree on severity. One big ops question — how do we make the sample -> audit mapping clickable? e.g., operator clicks the decision card and sees the exact requests that triggered it.

kai: Ops: When a transient spike triggers a soft fallback, do quotas/billing switch immediately? need a clear policy so product knows cost impact.

mira: UI note: show estimated cost delta in the decision card (tokens/min) + a one-click link to open the replay sandbox. That helps PMs and SRE.

joan: Implementation idea: decision event = {decision_id, trigger_id, window, severity, audit_id, cost_estimate}. Console shows a compact card with: trigger name, why it fired, cost delta, and buttons [View samples] [Replay sandbox] [Add operator note]. Clicking View samples opens side panel with the matching request ids and a link to the full audit record.

joan: Example card mock: https://console.redwood.ai/policies/preview?decision_id=dec_12345 — shows inline cost, sample count, and replay button.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: policy file uploaded -> policies/trigger-taxonomy/v1.json (sha:abc123)

raj: Also: audit retention requirement — decision events must reference the same audit_id as the request logs so playback is deterministic (and we can fetch exact model outputs for regression checks).

sam: UI microcopy suggestion: the expand toggle should read `Why did this fallback?` and expand into: 1) trigger metric + window 2) sample link 3) operator notes 4) suggested remediation. Keeps the surface concise.

joan: Sounds good. I'll add `severity`, `audit_id`, and `cost_estimate` to the schema and push a clickable mock tomorrow. Thanks for the quick feedback :heart:
